rawText: I got an email saying my staff account will be closed today if I don't verify it. I clicked the link and entered my password. The page looked like our normal login page.
Abeg check this matter. Person dey try enter my portal since morning. I don get like 7 login alerts from somewhere I no know.
My laptop suddenly became very slow after I installed a PDF reader from a website. Now some strange windows keep opening.
Someone sent me a WhatsApp message pretending to be my manager and asked me to urgently send a staff list. I sent it before realizing the number wasn't his.
We can't access the finance shared folder. All the files have strange extensions and there is a message asking us to pay money to restore them.
I received multiple OTP messages that I didn't request. A few minutes later I was logged out of my account.
The university website is showing a strange page instead of the normal homepage. It started sometime overnight.
I mistakenly sent an email containing the department's student result spreadsheet to the wrong external address.
Good afternoon, please help. My account dey tell me invalid password even though na the same password I always use. I didn't change anything.
There are several failed login attempts against the administrator account between 2:00am and 3:00am.
I downloaded a document from the email and immediately Microsoft Defender started showing an alert. I have not opened anything else.
Someone sent me this link and said it is the new staff welfare registration. The website is asking for my email, password and BVN.
We noticed that one employee's account accessed the payroll system at 3:17am. The employee was not working at that time.
My colleague's account started sending strange emails to people in the department. She says she didn't send them.
The server is behaving somehow. CPU usage has stayed around 100% for almost two hours and we found a process nobody recognizes.
A staff member received an email from what looks like HR asking for their bank details to process salary adjustment.
I saw a login notification from Lagos but I am currently in Abuja and haven't logged into the system today.
This morning all the computers in the lab started displaying the same warning. Some files cannot open anymore.
Someone called claiming to be from IT support. He asked me to read the code that was sent to my phone. I gave him the code.
I think I clicked something bad. The email said 'urgent invoice' and after I opened the attachment, my computer restarted by itself.
We found a database backup on a publicly accessible server. It contains customer names, phone numbers and email addresses.
Abeg I think say person don enter my account. I dey receive password reset emails wey I no request.
A strange USB was found connected to one of the computers in the research lab. Nobody knows who plugged it in.
Someone changed the administrator email address on our online service without authorization.
I got a message saying I won a staff appreciation reward and should click the attached link to claim it. I didn't click.
The same suspicious email was reported by three staff members this morning. It has the same sender and same link.
I received a strange email from an address that looks almost exactly like our registrar's email. The difference is one letter.
My system is showing files with names I don't recognize and my antivirus has been disabled.
Someone in the department accidentally shared a Google Drive folder containing internal research documents with 'Anyone with the link'.
The finance officer said she received an email from the VC asking her to urgently transfer money to a new account.
I noticed one of our service accounts making hundreds of requests to an internal server overnight. This is not normal.
Please help me. I clicked the link already. It asked me to login and now my account is requesting password reset.
The department's shared mailbox has been sending spam messages to external addresses since yesterday.
Our research server suddenly started communicating with an external IP address that we don't recognize.
I no fit access the student portal again. Someone changed the recovery email and password.
A lecturer received a message from someone pretending to be a student and asking for access to the lecturer's research folder.
We noticed that the same suspicious login happened on two different staff accounts within ten minutes.
The computer started displaying a fake antivirus warning saying I have 27 viruses and should install a particular program immediately.
An employee reported that a confidential research document was missing from the shared drive. Audit logs show someone accessed it shortly before it disappeared.
This message came through WhatsApp: 'Boss said send the latest customer list now.' The number isn't saved and the person refused to identify themselves.
A server administrator noticed that a new user account was created overnight with administrator privileges.
I received an email with a ZIP attachment from someone I don't know. I downloaded it but didn't open the file.
The same incident was reported yesterday by another staff member. Both reports mention the same suspicious domain and identical email subject.
Our website has been unusually slow and several users are reporting that they cannot access it. Network traffic is much higher than normal.
A staff member lost their work laptop at a conference. The laptop was logged into the corporate email account.
I clicked the 'verify payment' link from an email and entered my card details before noticing the website address was different from the real payment portal.
Someone dey send plenty failed login attempts to our VPN account. The attempts dey come from different IP addresses.
A researcher accidentally uploaded an internal research file to a public GitHub repository. It contained an API key used by the research application.
My computer is asking for a password to open files that were working normally yesterday. There is also a note saying payment is required.
I got this email three times today. First person reported it around 9am and now two other departments have received the exact same message with the same link.
